arabic_text: أَللَّهُمَّ إنِّي أَسْتَخِيرُكَ بِعِلْمِكَ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَاقْضِ لِيْ بِالْخِيَرَةِ
transliteration: allāhumma innī astakhiruka biʿilmika faṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihī wa aqḍi lī bil-khiyarah
english_text: O God, I ask from Thee the best in Thy knowledge, so bless Muhammad and his Household and decree for me the best!

arabic_text: وَأَلْهِمْنَا مَعْرِفَةَ الاخْتِيَارِ، وَاجْعَلْ ذَلِكَ ذَرِيعَةً إلَى الرِّضَا بِمَا قَضَيْتَ لَنَا وَالتَّسْلِيْمِ لِمَا حَكَمْتَ.
transliteration: wa alhimnā maʿrifat al-ikhtiyār wajʿal dhālika dhariʿatan ilā al-riḍā bimā qaḍayta lanā wal-taslīm li-mā ḥakamta
english_text: Inspire us with knowledge to chose the best and make that a means to being pleased with what Thou hast decreed for us and submitting to what Thou hast decided!

arabic_text: فَأَزِحْ عَنَّا رَيْبَ الارْتِيَابِ، وَأَيِّدْنَا بِيَقِينِ الْمُخْلِصِينَ،
transliteration: fa'azih 'anna rayba al-irtiyab wa ayyidnā biyaqīni almukhliṣīn
english_text: Banish from us the doubt of misgiving and confirm us with the certainty of the sincere!

arabic_text: وَلاَ تَسُمْنَا عَجْزَ الْمَعْرِفَةِ عَمَّا تَخَيَّرْتَ، فَنَغْمِطَ قَدْرَكَ، وَنَكْرَهَ مَوْضِعَ رِضَاكَ، وَنَجْنَحَ إلَى الَّتِي هِيَ أَبْعَدُ مِنْ حُسْنِ الْعَاقِبَةِ وَأَقْرَبُ إلَى ضِدِّ الْعَافِيَةِ.
transliteration: wala tasumnā ʿajz al-maʿrifati ʿammā takhayyart fanaghmita qadranka, wa nakrah maudha'a ridhak wa najnaha ila al-lati hiya ab'adu min husni al-'aqibah wa aqrabu ila ḍiddil-'afiyah
english_text: Visit us not with incapacity to know what Thou hast chosen, lest we despise Thy measuring out, dislike the place of Thy good pleasure, and incline toward that which is further from good outcome and nearer to the opposite of well-being!

arabic_text: حَبِّبْ إلَيْنَا مَا نَكْرَهُ مِنْ قَضَائِكَ وَسَهِّلْ عَلَيْنَا مَا نَسْتَصْعِبُ مِنْ حُكْمِكَ،
transliteration: ḥabbib ilaynā mā nakrahū min qaḍā’ika wasahhil ʿalayna ma nastaṣʿibu min ḥukmika
english_text: Make us love what we dislike in Thy decree and make easy for us what we find difficult in Thy decision!

arabic_text: وَأَلْهِمْنَـا الانْقِيَـادَ لِمَا أَوْرَدْتَ عَلَيْنَـا مِنْ مَشِيَّتِكَ حَتَّى لاَ نُحِبَّ تَأخِيْرَ مَا عَجَّلْتَ، وَلاَ تَعْجيْلَ مَا أَخَّرْتَ، وَلا نَكْرَهَ مَا أَحْبَبْتَ، وَلا نَتَخَيَّرَ مَا كَرِهْتَ،
transliteration: wa alhimnā alinqiyād limā awradta 'alaynā min mashyyatika ḥattá lā nuḥibba taʾakhir maʾ ʿajjalta walā taʿjil mā akhkhar-ta, wa-lā nakrah mā aḥbab-ta walā natakhyarra mā karithta
english_text: Inspire us to yield to that which Thou bringest upon us by Thy will, lest we love the delay of what Thou hast hastened and the hastening of what Thou hast delayed, dislike what Thou lovest, and choose what Thou dislikest!

arabic_text: وَاخْتِمْ لَنَا بِالَّتِي هِيَ أَحْمَدُ عَاقِبةً وَأكْرَمُ مَصِيراً
transliteration: wa-ikhtim lana bi-allati hiya ahmadu aaqibatan wa-akramu maseeran
english_text: Seal us with that which is most praised in outcome and most generous in issue!

arabic_text: إنَّكَ تُفِيدُ الْكَرِيمَةَ وَتُعْطِي الْجَسِيمَةَ، وَتَفْعَلُ مَا تُرِيدُ وَأَنْتَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْء قَدِيرٌ .
transliteration: 'innaka tufīdu l-karīmata wa tuʿṭī l-jasīmata wa tafʿalu ma turidu wa anta ʿala kulli shayʾin qadirun
english_text: Surely Thou givest generous gain, bestowest the immense, dost what Thou wilt, and Thou art "powerful over everything" (3:26).
